name: Fractured Ocean
introDiscord:
The ocean ahead is physically broken into floating slabs.

Water ends at clean edges and continues several feet away.

Fish cross the gaps anyway.
introTwitch:
The ocean ahead is physically broken into floating slabs.

Water ends at clean edges and continues several feet away.

Fish cross the gaps anyway.

fractured-ocean-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Fractured Ocean.

left.message:
One Berry sits at the edge of a floating sea fragment.

Shizuki wrote:

'Dropped second Berry over edge.

Berry fell UP.

Recovery impossible.'

right.message: A cache is embedded in the exposed side of a slice of ocean.

forward.message: A Fracturefin Shark bites through the boundary between two realities.

fractured-ocean-depths.prompt: Deeper within Fractured Ocean, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: A Shark disappears through one broken ocean edge and exits another.

right.message:
A stable fragment remembers being a calm tidepool.

The memory restores you.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message:
A coffer is split perfectly in half.

Both halves contain the full treasure.

Nexus economics.

fractured-ocean-threshold.prompt: Near Splitwater Arena, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: Star Candies hang between two pieces of disconnected water.

right.message: A Fracturefin Shark tears another crack open.

forward.message:
Shizuki's old bottle floats inside a fragment labeled:

'SAFE WATER.

Probably.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

boss-antechamber.name: Splitwater Arena
boss-antechamber.prompt: Splitwater Arena breaks into dozens of disconnected pieces.

bossPromptDiscord:
Splitwater Arena breaks into dozens of disconnected pieces.

Something enormous begins swimming through ALL of them.

Use /yes to continue or /no to choose an ocean that is
assembled correctly.
bossPromptTwitch:
Splitwater Arena breaks into dozens of disconnected pieces.

Something enormous begins swimming through ALL of them.

Use !yes to continue or !no to choose an ocean that is
assembled correctly.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Splitwater Arena. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
A massive jaw bites through the boundary.

Reality-Bite Apex reveals itself!

completionText:
The broken ocean settles.

It is still broken.

Apparently that counts.
